name: novel-game
description: NovelGame: a self-contained interactive fiction engine. Packages worldbuilding, characters, and rules into reusable settings; the AI auto-loads them and manages story progress, affinity, inventory, and branching saves — no need to re-describe your setup each session. Identifies request type, researches referenced works (e.g. 十日终焉, 异兽迷城, 未来日记) online, and builds the engine from the player's intent. English-first, with Chinese and Japanese output support.
